Doctors revealed that there was a choking mark by wire on her neck.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.newsnation.in/videos/world/hindu-girl-found-dead-in-pakistans-sindh-what-doctor-said-14/52286|title=Hindu Girl Found Dead In Pakistan's Sindh: What Doctor Said|website=News Nation|date=17 September 2019 |access-date=17 September 2019}}</ref> Police said that the girl may have committed suicide but her brother Vishal told the media he was convinced that his sister was murdered.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.newsx.com/national/hindu-girl-killed-in-pakistan-ghotki-namrita-chandani-larkana.html|title=Hindu girl from Pakistan's Ghotki found dead in her hostel room in Larkana, brother suspects murder, calls for help|date=17 September 2019|website=NewsX|access-date=17 September 2019}}</ref> He also appealed to the public to stand up for them as they are indeed a minority in Pakistan <ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/pak-hindu-girl-namrita-chandani-found-dead-in-hostel-room-family-claims-she-was-murdered-2102224|title=Pak Hindu Student Found Dead In Hostel Room, Family Alleges Murder|website=NDTV.com|access-date=2020-01-22}}</ref> The university vice-chancellor Anila told the media that Chandani's room was locked. She further added that the actual cause of death is yet to be confirmed.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://dailytimes.com.pk/467323/final-year-student-of-dental-surgery-found-dead-in-hostel/|title=Final-year student of dental surgery found dead in hostel|date=17 September 2019|website=Daily Times|access-date=17 September 2019}}</ref> According to the post-mortem report, no marks of torture have been found on the body.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.geo.tv/latest/247829-nimrita-kumari-was-murdered-claims-larkana-students-brother|title=Nimrita Kumari was murdered, claims Larkana student's brother|website=geo.tv|access-date=17 September 2019}}</ref> SSP Larkana is investigating the incident and has sealed her room for further investigation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thenews.com.pk/latest/527909-death-of-medical-student-nimrita-kumari-sparks-anger-on-social-media|title=Death of medical student Nimrita Kumari sparks anger on social media|website=The News International|access-date=17 September 2019}}</ref> It is suspected by some that Chandani might have been a victim of murder by fellow students. An investigation is looking into the leaked medical paper which Chandani opposed and raised her voice for.
